# Wallpaperama

> > Free HD wallpapers and desktop backgrounds for mobile and computer devices across hundreds of categories.

Wallpaperama is a comprehensive wallpaper collection site offering high-resolution backgrounds organized by theme including nature, celebrities, architecture, animals, and more. The site serves both desktop and mobile users with free downloads and an active community forum for wallpaper discussions.

## Key Topics

- HD wallpapers
- Desktop backgrounds
- Free downloads
- High-resolution images
- Celebrity wallpapers
- Nature photography
- Mobile wallpapers
- Landscape photography
- iPhone/iPad compatible
- Fractal art
- Video games
- Architecture
- Wildlife
- Holiday themes
- Wallpaper collection

## Core Galleries

- [Wallpaperama Home](https://wallpaperama.com): Homepage featuring free HD wallpapers and celebrity collections
- [All Wallpapers](https://wallpaperama.com/wallpapers): Main wallpaper gallery for mobile and desktop devices with HD backgrounds

## Nature & Landscape

- [Landscape Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/landscape.html): Scenic landscape wallpapers from Montana, San Diego, and Antarctica
- [Animal Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/animal.html): Animal wallpapers featuring wildlife including tigers, koalas, and pandas
- [Bird Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/bird.html): Bird wallpapers featuring macaws, penguins, hummingbirds, and toucans
- [Aquarium Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/aquarium.html): Aquarium and marine life wallpapers with fish and whale imagery
- [Flower Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/flower.html): Floral wallpapers featuring lavender, blue roses, and garden flowers
- [Garden Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/garden.html): Garden and botanical wallpapers with nature and landscape photography

## Celebrity & Entertainment

- [Celebrity Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/celebrity.html): Celebrity wallpapers for mobile and desktop with Jessica Alba and Rihanna
- [Babes Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/babes.html): Celebrity actress wallpapers featuring Beyoncé, Charlize Theron, and others
- [Game Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/game.html): Video game wallpapers featuring Need for Speed and gaming art
- [Member Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/member.html): Member collection wallpapers with celebrities and entertainment content

## Architecture & Landmarks

- [Architecture Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/architecture.html): Architecture wallpapers featuring landmarks like Eiffel Tower and Petronas Towers
- [Landmark Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/landmark.html): Iconic landmark wallpapers featuring Eiffel Tower and Statue of Liberty

## Vehicles & Technology

- [Automobile Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/automobile.html): Luxury and sports car wallpapers including Ferrari and Lamborghini models

## Art & Abstract

- [Fractal Wallpapers](https://www.wallpaperama.com/wallpapers/fractal.html): Abstract fractal and digital art wallpapers for desktop backgrounds

## Community & Seasonal

- [Wallpaperama Forums](https://wallpaperama.com/forums): Community forums for wallpaper discussions and user comments
